title: ConfirmStockReservation
description: Command (ADR 0006). Sent by order-service through its outbox (topic = this name, key = orderId). Consumed by inventory-service. Sent when the order becomes PLACED (BR-INV-04): every RESERVED line becomes CONFIRMED and its quantity is deducted (SALE). Group inventory-confirm-stock-reservation. Answered by StockReservationConfirmed or StockReservationConfirmationFailed.

merchantId.description: Owner of the order's store. inventory scopes every read and write by merchantId + storeId.

orderId.description: Saga id and Kafka key; one order belongs to one store (BR-ORD-01).
